messages:
Mia: Quick heads-up — next-week "crew-swarm" launch: X thread + LinkedIn carousel + webinar CTA. Need copy, hero image, 3 supporting cards, and inbound routing plan. Can we lock by EOD Thurs? :calendar:
Raj: on it. I'll draft the X thread and two headline variants. who has hero asset? @Noah?
Noah: Hero mock in progress, should have a first pass in 3 hrs. saving as: hero_launch_v1.png
Jules: Audience pivot: emphasize cost/perf benchmarks for dev audiences, but keep one variant focused on platform controls for enterprise. two narrative bento boxes.
Olivia: For inbound, plan is: webinar signups -> webhook -> HubSpot form -> SDR queue (EMEA/NA split). Will need tracking params. Who can add UTM+source tags?
Raj: I'll include UTMs in copy drafts. proposing CTA test A: "Join live — limited seats" vs B: "Save your seat / Recording available". Short X thread ends w/ link + 1-line value prop.
Mia: Good. Also want a lightweight follow-up DM script for folks who comment on X thread (ambassador outreach). Can we draft 3 variations?
Noah: Uploaded card comps to the drive: https://redwood.drive/crew-swarm/cards (cc: @Mia). Colors aligned with launch theme. If anyone needs the raw figma let me know.
Raj: Paste of initial X thread draft below — feel free to edit:

"1/ Developers: inference cost shouldn't be a mystery. We measured 3x lower token cost with simple batching — here's how we did it. [link]
2/ Key benchmark: 40ms median latency on 2k seq (public model).
3/ What we shipped: model routing + KV caching = predictable cost.
4/ Want the deep dive? Webinar Thurs 10am PT — seats limited: [signup link]"

Jules: Love the structure. Suggest swapping lines 2&3 to lead with outcome, then mechanism. also add enterprise note in a threaded reply on LinkedIn.
Olivia: Routing check — once someone signs, create a lead in HS with tag "launch_crew_swarm" and assign to SDR pool based on timezone. I'll add the automation runbook after we choose form fields.
seed-bot: Calendar created: "Crew Swarm Launch — Webinar" Thu 10:00 PT. Invite sent to: marketing@, growth@, ops@. Registration form URL: https://events.redwood.com/crew-swarm-10oct
Mia: Can everyone review copy + assets by 5pm today? Raj — can you push the two headline variants into the doc and mark chosen CTA? Noah — final 1x hero + 3 cards by EOD pls. Olivia — draft runbook and tagging scheme by midnight so ops can test the webhook.
Raj: will do. dropping both headlines in docs now.
Noah: aiming to deliver v1 by 4:40pm.
Olivia: I'll sketch the webhook steps and post them here for quick review.
Mia: thanks team. small ask — after launch we need 2 follow-up sequences: 1) attendees -> content drip, 2) non-attendees -> recording + product trial offer. we'll finalize tomorrow. :rocket:
